decisive_items: compound heterozygous alterations (c.2992 + 2T>G and c.8621-30A>G) at splice sites in COL7A1
Potentially revertant area epidermis: High rates of wild-type transcripts (35.0%)
A patch of healthy skin (7.5 × 4 cm²) on the left forearm, lacking blistering
response.rationale: R1 uniquely integrates the COL7A1 mutations (dystrophic EB) with the healthy patch showing high wild-type transcripts, indicating revertant mosaicism. R3 captures only the genetic disease, R2 only the mosaicism phenomenon.

rejected.why: Identifies dystrophic EB but omits the revertant mosaicism evidenced by the healthy patch and high wild-type transcripts.
Describes revertant mosaicism but fails to link it to COL7A1/dystrophic EB, missing the underlying diagnosis.
